title: Data-Related Challenges and Requirements for Event Log Generation in Process Mining: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.04211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process mining is becoming an essential technology that not only supports the improvement of business processes but also enables the software technologies underlying the future digital economy. Among the multiple challenges discussed by the process mining community, data quality is emerging as the most pressing one. However, insufficient attention has been paid to event log generation as the very first phase of process mining and to its relationship with data engineering and requirements engineering. To address this gap, we conducted a systematic literature review of data-related challenges, requirements, and solutions in event log generation. Our results show that a wide range of 29 challenges can be addressed with 5 basic categories of requirements. translated_title: 流程挖掘中事件日志生成的数据相关挑战与需求：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 流程挖掘正在成为一项重要的技术，它不仅支持业务流程的改进，还为支撑未来数字经济的软件技术奠定基础。在流程挖掘学界讨论的诸多挑战中，数据质量正成为最紧迫的挑战。然而，作为流程挖掘的第一个阶段，事件日志生成尚未得到足够的关注，其与数据工程和需求工程的关系也被忽视。为了填补这一空白，我们对事件日志生成中与数据相关的挑战、需求和解决方案进行了系统性文献综述。研究结果表明，多达29种挑战可以通过5个基本需求类别来应对。现有的解决方案已经为事件日志生成嵌入了某种形式的数据工程和领域知识工程技术。本综述可以为研究人员和从业者提供支持……
tldr: 本系统性文献综述识别了流程挖掘中事件日志生成面临的29种数据相关挑战，并将其归纳为5个基本需求类别，揭示了现有方案中数据工程与领域知识工程技术的应用。
en_tdlr: This systematic literature review identifies 29 data-related challenges in event log generation for process mining, which can be addressed through 5 basic categories of requirements, revealing the embedded data engineering and domain knowledge techniques in existing solutions.
